name: Plan delivery routes that cut miles and keep windows
outcome: Daily routes meet delivery windows while minimizing miles driven and vehicles used.
measures: miles and vehicles against the previous plan
description: This outcome is the original minus its trailing comparative clause, which required the routes to use fewer miles and vehicles than the previous plan. That clause is a measured comparison against a baseline the seller does not control, and it now sits in measures, where the same bar is applied to evidence. The third scm job to need this: scm.forecast-demand and scm.reorder-inventory were corrected the same way in #65. Two vendors were read against the old wording before proposing this, Samsara (#68) and Onfleet (#69), and neither could be filed under it; the job had zero claimants, so nothing in the registry moves under the change.
